about: Production-build size budget per emitted chunk, in bytes of gzip level 9 output. Each chunk is judged by the first rule whose pattern matches its file name; a chunk no rule matches fails the check. Lowering a limit is free. Any other change to a rule (a raised limit or Stage 2 target, a new, removed, rematched or reordered rule) needs a new changelog entry naming that rule. See scripts/bundle-budget.mjs.

changelog.change: Stage 1 of #971, set once #968 made the release build the minified one. Measured at 101d0904: entry 243,072, dialog host 191,285, heatmap-3d 159,867 bytes gzip.

Stage 2 of #971, activated by #969. Every dialog is now its own lazy chunk, so the catch-all drops from 200,000 to its Stage 2 target of 60,000, and both Stage 2 targets are retired as met (three's already equalled its limit). No dialog needs a rule of its own. The irrigation dialog was expected to, but it is the largest at 45,626 bytes gzip. Measured on 8f1b4002 plus #969: irrigation-dialog 45,626, strain-library-dialog 39,706, label-templates 37,841, config-dialog 37,552, dialog host 9,231 bytes gzip.
